# Types of Errors

In hypothesis testing, a Type I error (false positive) occurs when you incorrectly reject a true null hypothesis, while a Type II error (false negative) happens when you fail to reject a false null hypothesis. These are the two types of mistakes that can be made when deciding whether to accept or reject the null hypothesis, with their probabilities denoted by alpha (╬▒) and beta (╬▓), respectively.
